t: Call Tracking and Missed Call Text Back Through Google Business Profile
html:
Google Business Profile (GBP) allows a business to register two phone numbers, which creates an excellent opportunity for Agencies to track calls generated from Google Business Profile listings while keeping with SEO best practices (i.e.moving the business' real phone number to the secondary slot has not been found to negatively affect rankings).

The Eleva Google Business Profile integration enables you to automatically move your client's main business number to the secondary slot and add their Eleva number to the first slot.

When you toggle on GBP Call Tracking, the following happens: 

  • If the phone number in GBP is already a Eleva number from the Eleva sub-account, nothing will be changed as the business's calls are already being tracked in Eleva.
  • If the phone number in GBP is also the forwarding number for any of the Eleva numbers in the Eleva sub-account, Eleva will move the current number to the secondary slot and add the Eleva number in the primary slot.
  • If the phone number in GBP is not the forwarding number for any of the Twilio numbers in the corresponding Eleva sub-account, Eleva will move the current number to the secondary slot, add the Eleva number in the primary slot, and set the current number as the forwarding number for the Eleva number in the Eleva sub-account.

Which Eleva Number to Add to GBP

When you connect a Google Business Profile (GBP) to a location in Eleva, the platform automatically selects a Eleva number to push as the primary phone number in GBP. Here’s how that number is selected:

  1. Primary Location Number (Assigned in Phone Numbers tab):

    • If your location has a dedicated phone number assigned under Settings > Phone Numbers, that number will be used as the default tracking number pushed to GBP.

    • This is often the number created during onboarding or manual setup.

  2. First Number in the Sub-Account with Call Forwarding Enabled:

    • If no number is explicitly set as the primary, Eleva selects the first available number that has call forwarding enabled.

  3. Fallback to Any Available Number in the Sub-Account:

    • If no call forwarding is configured, Eleva will pick any available Eleva number in the location.

  4. No Number? You’ll Need to Assign One First:

    • If no number is found in the sub-account, the integration won't complete. You'll need to assign or create a number before GBP integration can function.

Real-Life Examples 

These examples show exactly what changes in Google Business Profile (GBP), where calls go, how Eleva tracks them, and when missed-call text back can fire.


Example 1: GBP Already Uses Your Eleva (Eleva) number

Scenario: The business’s GBP primary number is already a Eleva number from the connected Eleva sub-account.

What Happens When You Toggle GBP Call Tracking ON

  • Nothing changes in GBP (because calls are already going to a tracked number).

What It Looks Like in Real Life

  1. A customer searches “ABC Dental” on Google and taps Call.

  2. The call goes to the Eleva number (tracked in Eleva).

  3. If the team answers → call is logged in Eleva.

  4. If nobody answers → Missed Call Text Back can automatically text the caller (if enabled in the location settings).


Example 2: GBP primary number is the same as a forwarding number already used by a Eleva number

Scenario: GBP shows the business’s real number (like a landline), and that same number is already set as the forwarding number for one of the Eleva numbers in the Eleva sub-account.

What Happens When You Toggle GBP Call Tracking ON

  • Eleva moves the current GBP number to the secondary slot

  • Eleva puts the Eleva number in the primary slot

What It Looks Like in Real Life

  1. Before toggle: GBP primary = (555) 111-2222 (real number).

  2. After toggle: GBP primary = Eleva tracking number; GBP secondary = (555) 111-2222.

  3. Customer taps Call on Google → call hits the Eleva number (tracked).

  4. Eleva forwards the call to (555) 111-2222 (because it was already configured that way).

  5. If missed, Missed Call Text Back (if enabled) texts the caller from the Eleva number.
